macro_regime: Late-cycle uncertainty with Japan normalization stalled
thesis_summary: No actionable Japan thesis currently. BOJ normalization pace unclear, upcoming US data may shift global rate expectations, prefer to wait for clearer directional catalyst.
thesis_detail: After analyzing current macro conditions and reviewing the ADBE tech proposal, I see cross-currents that make a clear Japan call difficult. The upcoming US macro calendar (ISM PMI Aug 3, NFP Aug 7) could materially shift Fed expectations and global rate differentials - key drivers of USD/JPY and therefore EWJ performance for USD investors. Without clear BOJ guidance on next policy moves or visibility on China spillover effects, I prefer to maintain neutral positioning and wait for a clearer catalyst. The recent tech momentum (ADBE +25% month) suggests risk-on sentiment, but this may be late-cycle euphoria rather than sustainable growth acceleration. Japan benefits from risk-on environments, but if this is a false dawn, EWJ could underperform on yen strength + equity weakness combination.
key_data_points: ADBE showing +25% monthly momentum but -31.5% annual decline
Upcoming US ISM PMI and NFP could shift rate expectations
No clear BOJ policy catalyst visible
base_case: Range-bound action until macro clarity emerges
bull_case: US data confirms soft landing, supports Japan risk-on trade
bear_case: US slowdown fears drive yen strength + equity weakness
yen_view: neutral pending US data - could strengthen on growth fears or weaken on risk-on
